foundry_calls.text: You wedge a fallen slab against the door and wrap yourself in your bedroll. Sleep comes in fits, but it comes — and with morning, strength returns to your limbs.
foundry_calls.speaker: Sage

foundry_calls.text: 🌙 The party settles in for a long rest. (1/1 fully recovered.)
foundry_calls.speaker: GM

llm_calls: [Aria]: I bar the door, make a cold camp in the alcove, and settle in for the night.
